tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, above the source note's 2.36 probe trigger but below its proposed critical range. A high-gradient measurement can reveal whether an avalanche drop occurs.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients are below the stated critical range, so the avalanche threshold and strength are not identifiable from these rows.
The correlated pilot inputs and concave response do not distinguish these models from the threshold mechanism.
The high-gradient probe more directly tests the unresolved threshold at lower cost.
It does not address the threshold ambiguity.
